If you are after people who love knowing and seeing what's new in the auto market, this segment is definitely a good choice.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Aspirations and Dreams > Happiness Seekers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Aspirations and Dreams > Idea Seekers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Aspirations and Dreams > Love Aspirers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Aspirations and Dreams > Money Driven

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Conscientiousness > Life Planners

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Conscientiousness > Perfectionists

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Conscientiousness > Well Intentioned

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Bottled Up

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Brush Off

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Comfort Seekers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Contemplators
Cookie Birthday Segment: Contemplators respond to stress with careful thought. They require time to process events and their response, and this time is mostly spend alone. They rely on the perspective and lack of distraction that the natural world provides, but also appreciate the value of productive action.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Emotional
Cookie Birthday Segment: Emotional group members are characterised by their tendency to react extremely emotionally to stress and difficulties. They can feel overwhelmed by negative feelings, which they tend to internalise and to which they give a lot of attention and energy.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Hot And Cold

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Quick Fix

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Talk It Over

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Dealing with Stress > Work Hard Play Hard

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Party Animals

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Assured

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Influencer

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Persuasive

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Love > Dramatic Lovers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Love > Tender Hearts

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Love > True Romantics

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Love > Wavelength Romantics

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Neuroticism > Reflective

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Neuroticism > Analytical

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Openness > Curious

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Openness > Expressive

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Openness > Intelligent

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Resourcefulness > Experienced Workers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > Resourcefulness > Skilled Workers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Caring
Cookie Birthday Segment: Caring group members are very emotionally engaged and kind, and like to offer help and assistance to people around them. cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Chilled Out
Cookie Birthday Segment: Chilled Out group members aren't in a rush. They draw a lot of inspiration and take their cues from nature. They're calm, content, and extremely relaxed, and believe that maintaining this outlook is key to a positive future.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Downhearted

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Energetic Optimists

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Go Getters
Cookie Birthday Segment: Go Getters are very strong willed, with a focus on work and competition as routes to success. They already feel pretty successful and see the future as holding more opportunities for them to build on this success and become even more impressive.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Happy Now

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Uncertain Thinkers

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > UK > State of Mind > Wise Optimists

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > US > Agreeableness > Positive Idealists

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA > Personality > US > Agreeableness > Rat Racers

VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Daydreamers
Cookie Birthday Segment: Daydreamers are prone to bouts of fantasy and escapism when they are bored. They find inspiration both within themselves and from being challenged by others to think in different ways or perform for their entertainment.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Extraversion > Frustrated Extraverts
Cookie Birthday Segment: Frustrated Extraverts have a strong desire to be the life and soul of the party, but are undermined by an uncertainty over how to behave in social situations. This may be caused by a lack of social experience, which can lead to feelings of insecurity and inadequacy.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Neuroticism > Happy and Secure
Cookie Birthday Segment: Happy And Secure group members have an overwhelmingly positive approach to life. They are emotionally secure, calm in the face of adversity and believe that problems can be solved. They laugh off criticisms and insults.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Neuroticism > Internal Escapists
Cookie Birthday Segment: Internal Escapists have quite a self centred attitude and draw strength from a belief in their own abilities. They are quick to anger and place blame when they feel that they have been insulted or are experiencing problems. This can seem like bravado but they are prone to quite deep negative feelings which can make them feel trapped and in need of escape.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Neuroticism > Self Confident
Cookie Birthday Segment: Self Confident group members believe in themselves. They may be prone to occasional bouts of uncertainty and doubt, but overall they have a calm and centred approach to life and it's problems which is based in an unshakable conviction in their own abilities.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Openness > Creative
Cookie Birthday Segment: Creative group members are drawn to a wide variety of artistic pursuits. They are interested in seeing the outside world in unusual ways and finding personal ways to express their own inner world. They are imaginative, open to inspiration and tend to be extremely tolerant of other people and their experiences.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Openness > Logical
Cookie Birthday Segment: Logical group members are extremely practical thinkers and workers. They are uninterested in emotions or any deep sense of creativity, preferring less abstract thinking and working to plans. They are drawn to process and thrive in task driven environments.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Openness > Nice
Cookie Birthday Segment: Nice group members are open, creative and emotional, but they are also very practical. They value their emotions but also know where to draw the line in terms of succumbing to them. They are also very aware of the feelings and situations of others and like to help where they can. They consider themselves reliable and sensible and are drawn to others who they identify as the same.

cookie_birthday: VisualDNA Mobile & App > Personality > UK > Openness > Straightforward
Cookie Birthday Segment: Straightforward group members prefer a relaxed and carefree life to the ups and downs that come with placing great value on emotions. They feel that emotions tend to cloud judgement and prefer to place them to one side, allowing them to pursue simple pursuits unencumbered with too many thoughts or worries.
